author: AtditC
body:
Hello Avicus Senior Staff.
Here's my 5th application for the Moderator rank:

Age: 15
Timezone: Central European Timezone
Do you have access to TeamSpeak? Yes/No: Yes
Do you have access to Skype? Yes/No: Yes (ardit142r)
Do you have access to a recording software? Yes/No: *Yes, a very good one. I'm able to save the last 20 minutes which happened on my display in a video. This software is always running in the background and works great. This is very helpful to catch rule breakers, especially on TeamSpeak, but also on Minecraft. (It's called ShadowPlay)


CRITERIA 1: SELF REFLECTION/EVALUATION

Do you have any experience as a staff member on any servers?
-Yes, about ~5 months ago, I was Junior Mod for 3 weeks and 2 days, but I failed my trial. However in this short time, I learnt many important things about moderating and it was the best time on Avicus I ever had.

What is your biggest weakness and how do you believe it will affect your moderating? What is your biggest strength and how would this affect your moderating?
-Biggest weakness: I can't tell if this is still my biggest weakness, but in my trial, I often criticized the other staff members and even insulted them, instead of working with them to solve problems and improve the staff team. I don't know if it's still my biggest weakness, but it definitely was before. I probably improved on it so it won't affect my moderating again.
-Biggest strength: My biggest strength is activity. I was moderating more than 4 hours each day, in average, back in my first Junior Mod trial. The reason why I'm very active is because I spend a lot of my time on the computer, especially in holidays, and because I love moderating. But if we're talking about strength in moderating, I'd say "keeping an overview". With "keeping an overview" I mean keeping overview if there's many reports coming, if I'm alone on the server and if the players spam me with questions or if hackers are flooding the server. This all happened once in my previous trial and I managed it well.

How do you believe you can help improve the Staff Team?
-In activity (won't elaborate again); and just with being a good moderator who is following the rules and policies. I don't want to be anything more than just a good moderator.

What qualities does a leader need to have in your opinion? Do you consider yourself to be a leader? Why?
-*A good leader needs to deal with each scenario or situation that could happen and should always behave as a leader. He needs to be mature at all times, be constructive and this everywhere at any time. He also must treat everyone the same, no matter what private relation they have. Yes, I consider myself to be a leader. I have some experience with it, because I was Junior Mod and already learned a lot, especially from other moderators.

What attributes distinguish yourself from other players that qualify you to be a moderator?
-Activity & Availability: As I already wrote above, I'm very active and I always would come online if there are no other moderators on and if I have time.
-Informatic/Technical skills: I've been with computer since years and I gained much experience. If somebody needs help with TeamSpeak, the forums, Minecraft or anything else, I'm sure I can help.
-Ability to improve: Please read the answer to "How passionate are you about Avicus? What does Avicus mean to you?" at CRITERIA 3: OTHER and you'll understand why.

What skills do you believe you should have when interacting with the community? Do you believe you have these skills?
-When interacting with the community you have to be fair; respect everyone's opinion and don't prejudge based on what you think.
-Attitude & Behavior: Obviously, you have to act and behave as a staff member. You can't meme around all the day and you have to take others serious. Yes, I think I have these skills, now. (I didn't have them before.)

How much time can you commit to being a staff member (Rough Idea)?
-About 2-3 hours per day in average. At weekends, at least double the time per day. However, I don't want to promise that I will be as active as I was, but I promise to be over the average of the current staff team's activity.


CRITERIA 2: GENERAL SITUATIONS

You are currently undergoing your junior moderator trial. A ban evader is online and he is constantly ban evading and hacking. You are the only one online and the only one who is able to be online. What would you do?
-I'm very familiar with this situation. I went through it several times back when I was Jr. Mod.. Of course, I'd first ask for Mods on Discord via @here. If no Mod is coming, I'd just keep freezing the ban evader every time he reconnects - after I saved evidence of him hacking, of course. If no Mod comes online in the next 5-10 minutes and the situation gets harder to manage on my own, I'd ping them by @Moderators.

Another staff member is constantly joining and harassing other people on Teamspeak in their team channel. The staff member is also referee and has physical permissions to be in that channel. However the leaders do not want this staff member in there and they have asked him to leave multiple times. What would you do? A staff member shouldn't harass other players. I would ask them once more to stop and leave. If they don't, I'll report it to a Senior Moderator.

A player appeals a punishment you gave them. You realise that the evidence file is corrupted and therefore there is no physical evidence. You know however this person did indeed break the rules, what would you do?
-There's a very simple rule for all staff members: No evidence = no punishment. I keep this rule by heart. I'll appeal his punishment as soon as possible. However, if I see the player on the server once, I'll keep an eye on him.

You are in an Avicus team. One of your teammates is also an Avicus Staff member. One day in your team discord the team member/staff member posts a screenshot of a thread that only staff members can see. The content in the screenshot isn’t very important/confident but only staff members could see it on the forums. If anything, what would you do?
-I'd tell him to remove the screenshot and at the same time report it to a Senior staff member, because I'm not very sure what the rules about leaking are (yet).

One day the Senior Staff team makes a decision you do not agree with. You do not know all the details of the decision or the circumstances in which they were made and you were simply told by another staff member. However you do not like the decision based from what you know. What would you do?
-I'd try to get more information about the details, if I can't, I'll just let it be. I can't handle when I don't even know all about it.


CRITERIA 3: OTHER
NOTE: This is a new criteria and these questions are less to do with right/wrong answer and more to do with us getting to know you. Please answer these honestly. There is no right or wrong answer.

What would getting moderator on Avicus mean to you?
-Let me just tell you how it actually was, when I got promoted to Junior Mod the first time. The best memory I had on Avicus, after getting unbanned, was that I got promoted to Junior Mod after my interview. I was so happy at that moment that I could think of nothing else for the next hours except playing/moderating on Avicus.
I played more than 4 hours per day when I was promoted to Junior Mod, because I loved moderating and helping the community.

How passionate are you about Avicus? What does Avicus mean to you?
-Avicus definitely is my favorite gaming server. I love the community and the games it provides. Here a little story which shows how passionate I am about Avicus. I've been here for more than 3 years, and I love the server since more than 3 years. A little bit more than 2 years ago, I was banned permanently for excessive ban evading (they told me I would never get unbanned again but I kept fighting). After I got unbanned, I promised myself that I would never break any rules again, and in fact, I haven't gotten a single new infraction since 2 years now. I am very proud of that.

Do you speak any other languages than English?
-Yes, I can speak German too. It's my native language. I think it's important to have more German moderators, because there is only one right now, but many German Avicus players.

Do you have anything else to add to your application?
-Yes: 1) I put a * at the beginning of each answer to mark that the answers were copied from my last application, because they're similar/the same and still updated. 2) I wasn't very active in the past few months on the server, but if I'd get a Jr. Mod trial, my activity would increase quickly. 3) I've always tried to help Avicus in any possible way. I created the MusicBot for the community, reported tons of players/hackers on the forums, did lots of rank giveaways (to support Avicus financially) but the most efficient way to help Avicus is probably by moderating.

Greetings,
-Atdit
